# Reliable profile statistics card

`github-metrics.svg` is generated by [`lowlighter/metrics`](https://github.com/lowlighter/metrics)
and shown at the top of the profile README.

## Why this directory exists

The upstream action collects repository statistics (stars, forks, watchers, releases,
license, languages) with a single, large GraphQL query. For accounts with many
repositories that query regularly takes ~10 seconds and hits GitHub's API timeout.
When it fails, upstream is supposed to halve the batch and retry, but the retry is
broken: the `continue` in its error handler is inside a `do/while` loop whose
condition depends on values that are still `0`/`null` on the first attempt, so the
loop exits instead of retrying.

The result: the action reports success, an empty repository list is rendered, and the
card is committed with **0 Stargazers / 0 Forkers / 0 Releases / no languages**.
This happened on roughly half of the hourly runs (see the git history of
`github-metrics.svg` before 2026-11-11).

## How it is fixed here

1. `create-image.sh` pulls the same metrics image the upstream action uses
   (`ghcr.io/lowlighter/metrics:v3.34-beta`), replaces
   `source/plugins/base/index.mjs` with `base-index.patched.mjs` (a patched copy that
   really retries on API timeouts and paginates through all repositories), and tags
   the result as the local image `metrics:3.34.0`.
2. The workflow runs the action with `use_prebuilt_image: "no"`, which makes the
   action use that local image instead of pulling the unpatched one.
3. `commit-card.sh` renders up to two attempts and only commits a card whose
   stargazer total matches the REST API (owned, non-fork repositories). If every
   attempt fails, nothing is committed, so a good card is never overwritten by zeros.

The patched plugin is the upstream file (MIT license) plus the pagination/retry fix;
`create-image.sh` warns when the upstream file no longer matches the copy this patch
was written against.
